description: This Java class provides utility methods for managing logging within the OpenMRS platform, including retrieving log appenders, getting log file locations, and setting log levels dynamically.

classes.name: OpenmrsLoggingUtil
classes.description: Utility class for logging management in OpenMRS

methods.name: getMemoryAppender
methods.description: Retrieves the in-memory log appender used for displaying logging messages.

methods.name: getOpenmrsLogLocation
methods.description: Returns the file path to the OpenMRS log file, if available.

methods.name: applyLogLevels
methods.description: Sets log levels for different loggers based on a global property setting.

methods.name: applyLogLevel
methods.description: Sets a specific log level for a given class/logger.

methods.name: applyLogLevelInternal
methods.description: Internal method that applies a log level to a logger configuration; should be called within a synchronized context.

methods.name: reloadLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Reloads the logging configuration to apply recent changes.
